name: Aphra + 4LOM Omi
description:
Aphra is a squad that is necessary across many phases, and can really ramp up the offense. With IG90 the team is seeing a much higher survivability.
While the 5th slot can go to a wide variety of units, nothing beats 4LOM's Omi ability to buff IG90, making IG90 hit harder than BT2. It will give you more momentum to counter for the squad inherently being a bit squishy.
Does well for the first 4 phases, but can struggle on p5-p6.
notes: Aphra is required for a lot of missions
